prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate or the edit to make

image.description: Reference image(s) for editing or multi-reference generation (1-10)

size.description: Output size: 1K, 1.5K, 2K, or WIDTHxHEIGHT (921,600-4,624,220 total pixels)

output_format.description: Output image format. Provider default is png.

background.description: Background handling. "transparent" returns an RGBA PNG and requires png output.

watermark.description: Whether to add an AI-generated watermark to the output image
